title: Avoiding Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Drain Runs
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste line is a common mistake that causes frequent drain clogs. Standard tees direct wastewater at a sharp ninety-degree angle, which slows down flow velocity and allows solid waste to settle inside the pipe. For horizontal drain transitions, professional plumbers use combination wyes or long-turn sweep fittings. These fittings direct waste gradually in the flow direction, maintaining fluid momentum and reducing obstruction risk. Always verify local plumbing code requirements for approved fitting orientations before assembling horizontal drain lines.
